steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In December 2021, Equity Mates highlighted Rivian vehicles offering a built-in camp stove and wireless radio, presenting features aimed at off-grid or camping use.

episode.title: NZ hikes rates. Is Australia next?

views.text: In November 2021, Equity Mates described Rivian as an electric truck and van maker that listed on the Nasdaq while having never made a dollar, outlining its product focus.

episode.title: Boomtown - Airbnb, Rivian, Roblox and Crypto

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In December 2021, Equity Mates framed companies like Rivian as punts on what the market may look like in five to 10 years, highlighting uncertainty around future profitability amid cheap money.

episode.title: NZ hikes rates. Is Australia next?

views.text: In November 2021, Equity Mates noted Amazon owned 20 percent of Rivian and contracted it to build 100,000 electric delivery vans, portraying a powerful backer and a substantial committed customer base.

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In November 2021, Equity Mates explained Rivian planned to source production inputs offshore rather than build the machines that make the machines, indicating a different approach to investing in manufacturing capability.

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In February 2022, Equity Mates reported Rivian’s share price was down 41 percent and 64 percent since its November high, illustrating sharp valuation swings among hyped stocks.

episode.title: What to expect when you're expecting (a crash)

views.text: In November 2021, Equity Mates observed Rivian reached a US$113 billion market cap, exceeding General Motors and Ford, despite delivering 153 pickup trucks and losing US$1 billion, underscoring lofty expectations.

In October 2021, a guest on Equity Mates described Rivian’s pursuit of an $80 billion valuation with zero revenue as pie in the sky and outside a discipline that focuses on earnings leadership and reasonable valuation.

episode.title: Expert: Mary Manning - 3 stocks to watch as the world embraces renewables
